dn21:1.1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati, pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tassuttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ.
dn21:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena sakkassa devānamindassa ussukkaṃ udapādi bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
dn21:1.1.5: kahaṃ nu kho bhagavā etarahi viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddhoti.
dn21:1.1.6: addasā kho sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ magadhesu viharantaṃ, pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tassuttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ.
dn21:1.1.8: ayaṃ mārisā bhagavā magadhesu viharati pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo tassuttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ.
dn21:1.1.9: yadi pana mārisā mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyāma arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.
dn21:1.1.10: evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho devā tāvatiṃsā sakkassa devānamindassa paccassosuṃ.
dn21:1.2.1: atha kho sakko devānamindo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbadevaputtaṃ āmantesi:
dn21:1.2.2: ayaṃtāta pañcasikha bhagavā magadhesu viharati, pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tassuttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ.
dn21:1.2.3: yadi pana tāta pañcasikha mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyāma arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti”.
dn21:1.2.4: “evaṃ bhaddantavā’ti kho pañcasikho gandhabbadevaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā beluvapaṇḍuṃ vīṇaṃ ādāya sakkassa devānamindassa anucariyaṃ upāgami.
dn21:1.2.5: atha kho sakko devānamindo devehi tāvatiṃsehi parivuto pañcasikhena gandhabbadevaputtena purakkhato.
dn21:1.2.6: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evameva devesu tāvatiṃsesu antarahito magadhesu pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tassuttarato vediyake pabbate paccuṭṭhāsi.
dn21:1.3.1: tena kho pana samayena vediyako pabbato atiriva obhāsajāto hoti ambasaṇḍā ca brāhmaṇagāmo, yathā taṃ devānaṃ devānubhāvena.
dn21:1.3.3: ādittassu nāmajja vediyako pabbato jhāyatissu nāmajja vediyako pabbato, jalatissu nāmajja vediyako pabbato,
dn21:1.3.4: kiṃsu nāmajja vediyako pabbato atiriva obhāsajāto ambasaṇḍā ca brāhmaṇagāmo”ti
dn21:1.4.1: atha kho sakko devānamindo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbadevaputtaṃ āmantesi:
dn21:1.4.2: durupasaṅkamā kho tāta pañcasikha tathāgatā mādisena, jhāyī jhānaratā, tadantarapaṭisallīnā.
dn21:1.4.3: yadi pana tvaṃ tāta pañcasikha bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ pasādeyyāsi, tayā tāta paṭhamaṃ pasāditaṃ pacchā mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyāma arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.”
dn21:1.4.4: “evaṃ bhaddantavā”ti kho pañcasikho gandhabbadevaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā beluvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ ādāya yena indasālaguhā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā
dn21:1.4.5: ettāvatā me bhagavā neva atidūre bhavissati na accāsanena saddañca me sossatī’ti
dn21:1.4.8: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho pañcasikho gandhabbadeva putto beluvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ assāvesi. imā ca gāthā abhāsi buddhupasaṃhitā dhammupasaṃhitā saṅghupasaṃhitā arahantupasaṃhitā kāmūpasaṃhitā:
dn21:1.6.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbadevaputtaṃ etadavoca:
dn21:1.6.2: ‘saṃsandati kho te pañcasikha tantissaro gītassarena gītassaro ca tantissarena.
dn21:1.6.3: na ca pana te pañcasikha, tantissaro gītassaraṃ ativattati. gītassaro ca tantissaraṃ.
dn21:1.6.4: kadā saṃyūḷhā pana te pañcasikha, imā gāthā buddhupasaṃhitā dhammupasaṃhitā saṅghupasaṃhitā arahantupasaṃhitā kāmūpasaṃhitā’ti.
dn21:1.6.5: ekamidāhaṃ bhante, samayaṃ bhagavā uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā nerañjarāya tīre ajapālanigrodhamūle paṭhamābhisambuddho.
dn21:1.6.6: tena kho panāhaṃ bhante, samayena bhaddānāma suriyavaccasā timbaruno gandhabbarañño dhītā tamabhikaṅkhāmi,
dn21:1.6.7: sā kho pana bhante, bhaginī parakāminī hoti.
dn21:1.6.8: sikhaṇḍī nāma mātalissa saṅgāhakassa putto tamabhikaṅkhati.
dn21:1.6.9: yato kho ahaṃ bhante, taṃ bhaginiṃ nālatthaṃ kenaci pariyāyena,
dn21:1.6.10: athāhaṃ beluvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ ādāya yena timbaruno gandhabbarañño nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā beluvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ assāvesiṃ, imā ca gāthāyo abhāsiṃ buddhupasaṃhitā dhammupasaṃhitā saṅghupasaṃhitā arahantupasaṃhitā kāmūpasaṃhitā.
dn21:1.7.10: evaṃ vutte bhante, bhaddā suriyavaccasā maṃ etadavoca:
dn21:1.7.11: na kho me mārisa so bhagavā sammukhā diṭṭho. api ca suto yeva me so bhagavā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ upanaccantiyā,
dn21:1.7.12: yato kho tvaṃ mārisa taṃ bhagavantaṃ kittesi hotu no ajja samāgamoti.
dn21:1.7.13: ‘so yeva no bhante, tassā bhaginiyā saddhiṃ samāgamo ahosi,
dn21:1.8.2: paṭisammodati kho pañcasikho gandhabbadevaputto bhagavatā, bhagavā ca pañcasikhenā”ti.
dn21:1.8.3: atha kho sakko devānamindo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbadevaputtaṃ āmantesi:
dn21:1.8.5: sakko bhante devānamindo sāmacco saparijano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī’ti:
dn21:1.8.6: ‘evaṃ bhaddantavā’ti kho pañcasikho gandhabbadevaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādesi:
dn21:1.8.7: ‘sakko bhante, devānamindo sāmacco saparijano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī’ti.
dn21:1.8.8: ‘evaṃ sukhī hotu pañcasikha sakko devānamindo sāmacco saparijano,
dn21:1.8.9: sukhakāmā hi devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā, ye caññe santi puthukāyā’ti.
dn21:1.8.10: evañca pana tathāgatā evarūpe mahesakkhe yakkhe abhivadanti.
dn21:1.8.11: abhivadito sakko devānamindo bhagavato indasālaguhaṃ pavisitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
dn21:1.8.12: devā pi tāvatiṃsā indasālaguhaṃ pavisitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
dn21:1.8.13: pañcasikhopi gandhabbadevaputto indasālaguhaṃ pavisitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
dn21:1.9.1: tena kho pana samayena indasālaguhā visamā santī samā samapādi, sambādhā santī urundā samapādi. andhakāro guhāyaṃ antaradhāyi, āloko udapādi yathā taṃ devānaṃ devānubhāvena.
dn21:1.9.2: atha kho bhagavā sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca:
dn21:1.9.3: ‘acchariyamidaṃ āyasmato kosiyassa abbhutamidaāyasmato kosiyassa tāva bahukiccassa bahukaraṇīyassa yadidaṃ idhāṃ gamananti.’
dn21:1.9.4: cirappatikāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitukāmo. api ca devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ kehici kehici kiccakaraṇīyehi byāvaṭo evāhaṃ nāsakkhiṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
dn21:1.9.5: ekamidaṃ bhante samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati saḷalāgārake.
dn21:1.9.6: athakhvāhaṃ bhante sāvatthiṃ agamāsiṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
dn21:1.10.1: tena kho pana bhante samayena bhagavā aññatarena samādhinā nisinno hoti. bhuñjatī nāma vessavaṇassa mahārājassa paricārikā bhagavantaṃ paccupaṭṭhitā hoti pañjalikā namassamānā
dn21:1.10.4: sakko bhante devānamindo sāmacco saparijano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī”ti.
dn21:1.10.5: evaṃ vutte bhante sā bhuñjati maṃ etadavoca:
dn21:1.10.8: “tena hi bhagini yadā bhagavā tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhito hoti atha mama vacanena bhagavantaṃ abhivādehi.
dn21:1.10.9: sakko bhante devānamindo sāmacco saparijano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī”ti.
dn21:1.10.10: “kacci me sā bhante bhaginī bhagavantaṃ abhivādesi,
dn21:1.10.12: “abhivādesi maṃ sā devānaminda bhaginī, sarāmahaṃ tassā bhaginiyā vacanaṃ.
dn21:1.10.13: api cāhaṃ āyasmato ca nemisaddena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhito”ti.
dn21:1.11.1: “ye te bhante, devā amhehi paṭhamataraṃ tāvatiṃsakāyaṃ upapannā, tesaṃ me sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
dn21:1.11.2: “yadā tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammāsambuddhā, dibbā kāyā paripūranti hāyanti asurakāyā’ti,
dn21:1.11.3: taṃ me idaṃ bhante, sakkhidiṭṭhaṃ yato tathāgato loke uppanno arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dibbā kāyā paripūranti, hāyanti asurakāyā ti.
dn21:1.11.5: idheva bhante, kapilavatthusmiṃ gopikā nāma sakyadhītā ahosi buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṅghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrakārinī.
dn21:1.11.6: sā itthittaṃ virājetvā purisattaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā
dn21:1.11.7: devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ amhākaṃ puttattaṃ ajjhupagatā.
dn21:1.11.10: aññe pi bhante, tayo bhikkhū bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā hīnaṃ gandhabbakāyaṃ upapannā.
dn21:1.11.11: te pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgibhūtā paricārayamānā amhākaṃ upaṭṭhānamāgacchanti amhākaṃ pāricariyaṃ.
dn21:1.11.12: te amhākaṃ upaṭṭhānamāgate amhākaṃ pāricariyaṃ gopako nāma devaputto paṭicodesi:
dn21:1.11.13: “kutomukhā nāma tumhe mārisā tassa bhagavato dhammaṃ assutthā
dn21:1.11.14: ahaṃ hi nāma itthikā samāna buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṅghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrakārinī itthittaṃ virājetvā purisattaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ sakkassa devānamindassa puttattaṃ ajjhupagatā.
dn21:1.11.17: tumhe pana mārisā bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā hīnaṃ gandhabbakāyaṃ upapannā.
dn21:1.11.18: duddiṭṭharūpaṃ vata bho addasāma ye mayaṃ addasāma sahadhammike hīnaṃ gandhabbakāyaṃ upapanne’ti”.
dn21:1.11.19: tesaṃ bhante gopakena devaputtena paṭicoditānaṃ dve devā diṭṭheva dhamme satiṃ paṭilabhiṃsu kāyaṃ brahmapurohitaṃ, eko pana devo kāme ajjhāvasi.
dn21:1.12.66: na tattha kiṃ kaṅkhati koci sāvako,
dn21:1.13.2: dīgharattaṃ visuddho kho ayaṃsakko yaṃ kiñci maṃ pañhaṃ pucchissati, sabbaṃ taṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ yeva pucchissati, no anatthasaṃhitaṃ. yaṃ
dn21:1.13.3: cassāhaṃ puṭṭho byākarissāmi. taṃ khippameva ājānissatī”ti.
dn21:1.13.4: atha kho bhagavā sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
dn21:2.1.1: katāvakāso sakko devānamindo bhagavatā imaṃ bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ pañhaṃ apucchida:
dn21:2.1.2: kiṃsaññojanā nu kho mārisa devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā ye caññe santi puthukāyā te
dn21:2.1.3: ‘averā adaṇḍā asapattā abyāpajjā viharemu averino’ti iti ce nesaṃ hoti. atha ca pana saverā sadaṇḍā sasapattā sabyāpajjā viharanti saverino”ti.
dn21:2.1.4: itthaṃ sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi.
dn21:2.1.6: “issāmacchariyasaññoyojanā kho devānaminda devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā, ye caññe santi puthukāyā, te
dn21:2.1.7: ‘averā adaṇḍā asapattā abyāpajjā viharemu averino’ti iti ce nesaṃ hoti. atha ca pana saverā sadaṇḍā sasapattā sabyāpajjā viharanti saverino ti.
dn21:2.1.8: itthaṃ bhagavā sakkassa devānamindassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākāsi.
dn21:2.1.9: attamano sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi anumodi:
dn21:2.1.11: tiṇṇā me’ttha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṃkathā bhagavato pañhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā”ti.
dn21:2.2.1: itiha sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhamapucchi:
dn21:2.2.2: “issāmacchariyaṃ pana mārisa, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ,
dn21:2.2.5: issāmacchariyaṃ kho devānaminda, piyāppiyanidānaṃ piyāppiyasamudayaṃ piyāppiyajātikaṃ piyāppiyapabhavaṃ,
dn21:2.2.8: “piyāppiyaṃ kho pana mārisa, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ.
dn21:2.2.11: “piyāppiyaṃ kho devānaminda, chandanidānaṃ chandasamudayaṃ chandajātikaṃ chandappabhavaṃ
dn21:2.2.14: “chando kho pana mārisa, kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃpabhavo,
dn21:2.2.17: chando kho devānaminda, vitakkanidāno vitakkasamudayo vitakkajātiko vitakkapabhavo,
dn21:2.2.20: vitakko kho pana mārisa, kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃpabhavo,
dn21:2.2.23: vitakko kho devānaminda, papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno papañcasaññāsaṅkhāsamudayo papañcasaññāsaṅkhājātiko papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpabhavo,
dn21:2.3.1: kathaṃ paṭipanno pana mārisa, bhikkhu papañcasaññāsaṅkhānirodhasāruppagāminīpaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hotī’ti.
dn21:2.3.9: somanassampāhaṃ devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.3.11: ‘imaṃ kho me somanassaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpaṃ somanassaṃ na sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.3.13: ‘imaṃ kho me somanassaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpaṃ somanassaṃ sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.3.14: tattha yañce savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ yañce avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ ye avitakkaavicāre te paṇītatare.
dn21:2.3.15: somanassampāhaṃ devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti.
dn21:2.3.17: domanassampāhaṃ devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.3.19: ‘imaṃ kho me domanassaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpaṃ domanassaṃ na sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.3.21: ‘imaṃ kho me domanassaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpaṃ domanassaṃ sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.3.22: tattha yañce savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ yañce avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ, ye avitakkaavicāre te paṇītatare.
dn21:2.3.23: domanassampāhaṃ devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti.
dn21:2.3.25: upekkhampāhaṃ devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
dn21:2.3.27: imaṃ kho me upekkhaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpā upekkhā na sevitabbā.
dn21:2.3.29: imaṃ kho me upekkhaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpā upekkhā sevitabbā.
dn21:2.3.30: tattha yañce savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ yañce avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ ye avitakkaavicāre te paṇītatare.
dn21:2.3.31: upekkhampāhaṃ devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti.
dn21:2.3.32: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.3.33: evaṃ paṭipanno kho devānaminda, bhikkhu papañcasaññāsaṅkhānirodhasāruppagāminīpaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hotīti.
dn21:2.3.34: itthaṃ bhagavā sakkassa devānamindassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākāsi.
dn21:2.3.35: attamano sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi anumodi.
dn21:2.3.37: tiṇṇā me’ttha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṃkathā bhagavato pañhaveyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā”ti.
dn21:2.4.1: itiha sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
dn21:2.4.2: “kathaṃ paṭipanno pana mārisa, bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṃvarāya paṭipanno hotī?ti”.
dn21:2.4.9: kāyasamācārampāhaṃ devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.11: imaṃ kho me kāyasamācāraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpo kāyasamācāro na sevitabbo.
dn21:2.4.13: imaṃ kho me kāyasamācāraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpo kāyasamācāro sevitabbo.
dn21:2.4.16: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.18: sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.19: tattha yaṃ jaññā vacīsamācāraṃ imaṃ kho me vacīsamācāraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpo vacīsamācāro na sevitabbo.
dn21:2.4.20: tattha yaṃ jaññā vacīsamācāraṃ imaṃ kho me vacīsamācāraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpo vacīsamācāro sevitabbo.
dn21:2.4.23: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.25: sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.26: tattha yaṃ jaññā pariyesanaṃ imaṃ kho me pariyesanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpā pariyesanā na sevitabbā.
dn21:2.4.27: tattha yaṃ jaññā pariyesanaṃ imaṃ kho me pariyesanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpā pariyesanā sevitabbā.
dn21:2.4.30: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.31: evaṃ paṭipanno kho devānaminda, bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṃvarāya paṭipanno hotī’ti.
dn21:2.4.32: itthaṃ bhagavā sakkassa devānamindassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākāsi.
dn21:2.4.33: attamano sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi anumodi:
dn21:2.4.35: tiṇṇā me’ttha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṃkathā bhagavato pañhaveyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā”ti.
dn21:2.5.1: itiha sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
dn21:2.5.2: “kathaṃ paṭipanno pana mārisa bhikkhu indriyasaṃvarāya paṭipanno hotī?”ti.
dn21:2.5.15: evaṃ vutte sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn21:2.5.16: imassa kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
dn21:2.5.17: yathārūpaṃ bhante, cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ na sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.5.18: yathārūpañca kho bhante, cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti evarūpaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.5.19: yathārūpañca kho bhante, sotaviññeyyaṃ saddaṃ sevato …pe…
dn21:2.5.23: manoviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti evarūpo manoviññeyyo dhammo na sevitabbo.
dn21:2.5.24: yathārūpañca kho bhante, manoviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti evarūpo manoviññeyyo dhammo sevitabbo.
dn21:2.5.25: imassa kho me bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānato
dn21:2.5.26: tiṇṇā me’ttha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṃkathā bhagavato pañhaveyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā”ti.
dn21:2.6.1: itiha sakkā devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
dn21:2.6.2: “sabbeva nu kho mārisa samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekantavādā ekantasīlā ekantachandā ekantaajjhosānā”ti.
dn21:2.6.3: “na kho devānaminda, sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekantavādā ekantasīlā ekantachandā ekantaajjhosānā”ti.
dn21:2.6.4: “kasmā pana mārisa, na sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekantavādā ekantasīlā ekantachandā ekantaajjhosānā?”ti.
dn21:2.6.6: tasmiṃ anekadhātunānādhātusmiṃ loke yaṃ yadeva sattā dhātuṃ abhinivisanti, taṃ tadeva thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharanti
dn21:2.6.8: tasmā na sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekantavādā ekantasīlā ekantachandā ekantaajjhosānā”ti.
dn21:2.6.9: “sabbeva nu kho mārisa, samaṇabrāhmaṇā accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosānā?”ti.
dn21:2.6.10: “na kho devānaminda, sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosānā”ti.
dn21:2.6.11: “kasmā pana mārisa, na sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosānā”ti.
dn21:2.6.12: “ye kho devānaminda, bhikkhū taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttā te accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosānā.
dn21:2.6.13: tasmā na sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosānā”ti.
dn21:2.6.14: itthaṃ bhagavā sakkassa devānamindassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākāsi.
dn21:2.6.15: attamano sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi anumodi.
dn21:2.6.17: tiṇṇā me’ttha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṃkathā bhagavato pañhaveyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā”ti.
dn21:2.6.18: itiha sakko devānamindo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn21:2.7.1: ejā bhante rogo ejā gaṇḍo ejā sallaṃ ejā imaṃ purisaṃ parikaḍḍhati tassa tasseva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.
dn21:2.7.3: yesvāhaṃ bhante, pañhānaṃ ito bahiddhā aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu okāsakammampi nālatthaṃ, te me bhagavatā byākatā.
dn21:2.7.4: dīgharattānusayitañca pana me vicikicchā-kathaṃkathāsallaṃ, tañca bhagavatā abbuḷhanti.
dn21:2.7.5: abhijānāsi no tvaṃ devānaminda, ime pañhe aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇe pucchitā”ti.
dn21:2.7.6: “abhijānāmahaṃ bhante, ime pañhe aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇe pucchitā”ti.
dn21:2.7.7: “yathākathaṃ pana te devānaminda byākaṃsu, sace te agaru bhāsassū”ti.
dn21:2.7.8: “na kho me bhante, garu yatthassa bhagavā nisinno bhagavantarūpo vā”ti.
dn21:2.7.10: “ye svāhaṃ bhante, maññāmi samaṇabrāhmaṇā āraññakā pantasenāsanā’ti, tyāhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ime pañhe pucchāmi. te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti, asampāyantā mamaṃ yeva paṭipucchanti’
dn21:2.7.15: ‘kiṃ panāyasmā devānaminda kammaṃ katvā imaṃ ṭhānaṃ patto’ti.
dn21:2.7.18: ‘sakko ca no devānamindo diṭṭho yañca no apucchimha tañca no byākāsī’ti.
dn21:2.7.19: te aññadatthu mamaṃ yeva sāvakā sampajjanti, na cāhaṃ tesaṃ.
dn21:2.7.20: ahaṃ kho pana bhante, bhagavato sāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
dn21:2.7.22: “abhijānāsi no tvaṃ devānaminda, ito pubbe evarūpaṃ veda paṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhanti?”
dn21:2.7.23: “abhijānāmahaṃ bhante, ito pubbe evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhanti.”
dn21:2.7.24: “yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ devānaminda, abhijānāsi ito pubbe evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhanti?”
dn21:2.7.26: tasmiṃ kho pana bhante, saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu, asurā parājiyiṃsu.
dn21:2.7.27: tassa mayhaṃ bhante, taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmassa etadahosi:
dn21:2.7.28: ‘yā ceva dāni dibbā ojā yā ca asurā ojā ubhayamettha devā paribhuñjissantatī ti.
dn21:2.7.29: so kho pana me bhante, vedapaṭilābho somanassapaṭilābho sadaṇḍāvacaro sasatthāvacaro na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
dn21:2.7.30: yo kho pana me ayaṃ bhante, bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā vedapaṭilābho somanassapaṭilābho, so adaṇḍāvacaro asatthāvacaro ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattatī”ti.
dn21:2.8.1: “kiṃ pana tvaṃ devānaminda, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassa paṭilābhaṃ pavedesī?”ti.
dn21:2.8.2: “cha kho ahaṃ bhante, atthavase sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemī”ti.
dn21:2.8.7: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, paṭhamaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.12: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, dutiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.17: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, tatiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.22: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, catutthaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.27: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, pañcamaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.32: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, chaṭṭhaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.33: ime kho ahaṃ bhante, cha atthavase sampassamāno evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.10.1: atha kho sakko devānamindo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbaputtaṃ āmantesi.
dn21:2.10.2: bahūpakāro kho me’si tvaṃ tāta pañcasikhaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ pasādesi.
dn21:2.10.3: tayā tāta paṭhamaṃ pasāditaṃ pacchā mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamimha arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ.
dn21:2.10.4: pettike ca ṭhāne ṭhapayissāmi, gandhabbarājā bhavissasi, bhaddañca te suriyavacchasaṃ dammi, sā hi te abhipatthitā”ti.
dn21:2.10.5: atha kho sakko devānamindo pāṇinā paṭhaviṃ parāmasitvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
dn21:2.10.9: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne sakkassa devānamindassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
dn21:2.10.12: iti ye sakkena devānamindena ajjhiṭṭhapañhā puṭṭhā, te bhagavatā byākatā.
